title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：pair　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pair 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the tailor ① made the pair that no customer in the shop would have counted, and he said the making was the whole of the week. The ② pair, meaning the set itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a pair, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ pair in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ pair at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pair, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the tailor said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pair was the whole of the matter, meaning the match and not the set. The ⑥ pair, meaning the match and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; pair, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a set and a match. He said the match is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ pair had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ pair of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of counting; pair, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pair I remember is the set counted in the order, which closed in 1993 and is still counted as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ pair, my mother said in 1995, is the only set that improves by being counted; every pair, she said, is a match that has agreed to look like a set. She said the match was the honest half.

pair 意为“一对；一双”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pair 意为“一对、相配”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这对相配就是那件事的全部。
pair 意为“相配”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那对一对，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pair 意为“一对；一双”，指订单簿里写到、被清点的那一对，到 1991 年这一对成了订单簿里的一行。
pair 意为“一对之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的一对之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的清点。
pair 意为“一对；一双”，我记得的是订单簿里清点过的那一对，1993 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一对。
